text:
monitoring-bot: INCIDENT ALERT 1777654322 — ap-southeast-1 regional_error_rate and cross_region_imbalance firing. Pager: sam
sam: I'm on it. seeing elevated 504s + p99 spikes for /v1/embeddings in ap-southeast. error-rate ~4.5% over 5m.
alina: joining. any deploys? traffic shift? @sam
sam: no deploys in last hour. routing logs show a sudden influx of small embedding requests from many orgs but an unusually high number of concurrent streams from org-211.
devon: infra metrics show heavy KV cache churn on ap-southeast pool: eviction_rate spiked, and node-level oom_retries increased. hypothesis: lots of small embedding jobs with high fanout causing rapid cache invalidation + eviction thrash.
ops-bot: Runbook: for suspected KV eviction thrash, consider routing heavy tenants to a regional fallback, reduce concurrency, or increase eviction headroom. https://runbooks.redwood/kv-eviction
sam: mitigation plan: 1) override org-211 to ap-northeast-1 fallback; 2) temporarily reduce max_concurrency for ap-southeast inference-pool; 3) silence noisy machine-level alerts while we stabilize. executing route change now.
sam: routingctl apply --org org-211 --region ap-northeast-1 --reason "eviction-thrash-mitigation"
alina: override applied. synthetic checks to ap-northeast show embeddings successful. ap-southeast error-rate down from 4.5% -> 1.6% over last 3m.
devon: still seeing eviction loops on 2 hosts. I'll cordon and restart those hosts to clear caches. taking them out of rotation.
ops-bot: Automated failover detector flagged ap-southeast as a "candidate" for regional failover due to divergence, but requires manual approval: signal needed: FAILOVER_APPROVE.
sam: do not approve full failover. this looks localized to cache pressure from high-fanout embedding patterns. we'll stabilize without a global failover. taking handoff to alina for next 40m. notes: org override in place, concurrency reduced from 32->16, two nodes draining.
alina: thanks. I'll silence repeated alerts: ap_region_error_rate (squelch 25m) and node_oom_retries (squelch 15m). Will not silence failover_candidate alerts. Also creating a short-term alert to catch sustained eviction: kv_eviction_rate > 0.25 for 10m.
devon: logs snippet from worker-12:

```
2026-05-10T02:14:11Z worker-12 WARN kv_cache: eviction_rate=0.41, active_keys=980k
2026-05-10T02:14:13Z worker-12 ERROR request: embed_batch_handler: fanout=128, queue_ms=420, grpc_timeout
```

alina: looks like high fanout embedding jobs. options: enforce per-request fanout limits at router, add embedding request coalescing, or increase cache headroom for ap-southeast. short-term: I'll push a router rule to cap fanout to 64 and return a 429 with guidance for larger fanout.
sam: go ahead with the router rule. also please add a dashboard panel for "fanout by org" and a diffs panel comparing pre/post rule.
alina: router change deployed. synthetic checks good. ap-southeast error-rate now 0.6%. draining nodes completed, caches cleared.
ops-bot: timeline (automated): created=1777654322, route_override=1777654380, concurrency_cap=1777654445, node_drain_start=1777654480, router_fanout_cap=1777654600
devon: customer impact scan: org-211 experienced ~14 minutes at ~9% error-rate. a few other orgs saw 1-2 minute blips. CS notified.
cs-bot: Notifying CS: incident impacted org-211. Assigned @dina to handle customer outreach.
dina: acknowledged 12 will prepare outreach and recommend batching + reduced fanout or dedicated capacity.
alina: post-incident action items I will open:
- adjust alerting thresholds to reduce noise: bump ap_region_error_rate threshold from 0.5% -> 1.0% over 5m for region-level alerts
- create new alert: sustained_kv_eviction_rate > 0.25 for 10m (notify infra team)
- add per-org fanout heatmap to multi-region failover dashboard
- parametrize failover monitor to require (region_error > threshold) AND (global_spare_capacity < 25%) before promoting candidate
- infra ticket: KV cache sizing and eviction tune for ap-southeast (INF-177765)

alina: proposed PromQL tweak (ap_region_error_rate):

```
# current
sum(rate(http_responses_total{region="ap-southeast",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{region="ap-southeast"}[5m])) > 0.005

# proposed
(sum(rate(http_responses_total{region="ap-southeast",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{region="ap-southeast"}[5m]))) > 0.01
```

devon: +1 on adjustment. Also suggest we add a secondary guard in failover rule: require spare_capacity < 0.25 AND not_recent_deploys(15m) to avoid triggering on post-deploy noise.
alina: good call. I'll include both in PR.
sam: I'm adding: ensure failover alerts include top contributing orgs and fanout histogram so oncall can quickly see if this is a tenant-driven issue vs infra regression.
devon: dashboard plan: panels: region_error%, p95/p99 latency, spare_capacity_ratio, top-orgs-by-fanout, per-node-eviction_rate heatmap, recent_deploys overlay. Also add canary tests that simulate high-fanout embedding streams to catch regressions.
alina: creating tickets: MON-17776501 (alert tuning + PR), DASH-17776502 (multi-region dashboard + fanout heatmaps), INF-17776503 (kv-cache sizing + eviction policy). assigning MON to devon.
ops-bot: Created MON-17776501 12 alert tuning (assignee: devon). ETA PR 3 days, dashboard 7 days.
cs-bot: Dina will reach out to org-211 and offer remediation.
dina: sending initial outreach now. offering suggestions: cap fanout, use batching, consider Redwood Dedicated if high sustained throughput.
alina: incident RESOLVED 1777654899 12 rollback? none needed; mitigations and routing adjustments restored region health. Will run 48h watch and schedule postmortem tomorrow 09:30 UTC.
monitoring-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED 1777654899 12 summary posted to /incidents. Follow-ups: MON-17776501, DASH-17776502, INF-17776503

# quick RCA summary:
root cause = high fanout embedding traffic from a single tenant (org-211) causing KV-cache eviction thrash on ap-southeast pool; amplified by lack of per-request fanout caps and tight eviction headroom.
mitigations = route offending tenant to fallback region, reduce pool concurrency, cap request fanout at router, drain and restart thrashing nodes.
customer impact = org-211 had elevated errors for ~14 minutes; some minor blips for others. CS outreach in progress.
next steps = alert threshold changes, dashboard rollout with fanout heatmap, parametrize failover predicate, KV cache sizing audit.
